metadata.title: High-Key Portrait with Geometric Sans-Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, overexposed portrait style where the subject's white clothing blends into a pure white background, anchored by clean geometric sans-serif text in the lower third.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
busy or textured backgrounds are needed
serif or decorative typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist composition featuring a subject in white against a white background, creating a seamless 'floating head' effect. The image is defined by high-contrast facial features and sharp, modern typography placed horizontally across the lower half.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's white clothing merging with the white background
High-contrast blue eyes and warm skin tones against a cool white field
Large primary text balanced by smaller, offset secondary text
Geometric letterforms echoing the circularity of the subject's eyes
coreInvariants: Overexposed white-on-white background and clothing relationship
Geometric sans-serif typography with circular 'o' and 'a' counters

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered in the upper half, medium-close-up scale, looking directly at the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large blue typography serve as the primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, moves down to the large blue text, and finally to the smaller gold text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space occupies the majority of the frame, particularly the sides and bottom.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden tan (secondary text and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation overall, with localized saturation in the eyes and text.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'y' has a straight, diagonal descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same typeface family or similar geometric skeletons.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the circular counters and geometric 90s aesthetic.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and monolinear weight.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a subject wearing white, positioned in the upper half of the frame. The lighting should be so bright that the white clothing and white background merge seamlessly, leaving only the face and hair visible with high contrast.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add geometric sans-serif text in the lower third. The primary text should be large and blue, left-aligned. The secondary text should be smaller, golden-tan with a thin outline, positioned below and to the right of the primary text.

verificationChecks: Does the clothing blend into the background?
Are the 'o' and 'a' characters perfectly circular?
Is the text hierarchy established by color and size?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate the exact facial features of the reference subject

avoid: Visible seams between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the white field
Verify geometric proportions of the typeface
Confirm high-key lighting on the subject's face
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + white-on-white blending + geometric sans-serif typography in lower third.
